cohort: 616 pregnant women and 544 puerperal women who attended a telemonitoring program
finding: Telemonitoring was a feasible method for continuing prenatal care during the COVID-19 pandemic, even in institutions with limited telemedicine experience, with perinatal outcomes appearing similar to the general population.
mod_finding: Approximately 53% of the pregnant women included in this study who participated in a telemonitoring program underwent cesarean section.
